_comment: Spoken-only pronunciation fixes. Key = word as written (case-insensitive, whole word). Value = a pronunciation hint like "thee-ah-cast" (Kokoro gets it joined, "Theeahcast"; the LTX presenter gets "Thee-ah-cast"), or {"tts": "...", "presenter": "..."} to set each engine explicitly. Captions/on-screen text keep the original spelling. Per-video overrides come from the chat ("X is pronounced Y").
